counterfactual_missing_items: histopathology of the recurrent lesion was not provided
immunohistochemistry to exclude GIST or leiomyoma was not reported
endoscopic ultrasound or biopsy of the recurrence was not described
decisive_items: recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site
a 70 × 50 × 55 mm hypoechogenic, subcardial mass on the posterior gastric wall
response.rationale: C1 integrates the histopathologically confirmed lipoma with the directly stated recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site, making it the most complete and clinically consistent diagnosis. R1 captures the lipoma but omits the recurrence, while R3, R5, and R2 are contradicted by the lipoma histopathology and lack specific raw-supporting features.

rejected.why: Histopathology confirmed lipoma; no raw evidence of adenocarcinoma or malignant transformation.
Histopathology confirmed lipoma; no raw evidence of GIST-specific features such as CD117/DOG1 or spindle-cell morphology.
Histopathology confirmed lipoma; no raw evidence of smooth-muscle origin or leiomyoma-specific findings.
